This is a Real & blocking silent-failure latent bug against the project's "Fail fast — never hide failures" critical rule; a guard whose sole job is preventing the strand must not itself fail silently when an active status crosses an unannounced threshold (`tasks/` is ~715 dirs and grows monotonically). Classifying a silent-failure bug by what it DOES (not by fix size or current latency) makes it blocking. Codex's MAJOR #1 (the incremental-path bypass) is real too, but bounded and plan-authorized (plan §9 sanctioned the bypass): Gate 2 (the nested-store parity guard) STILL runs on the incremental path (line 642, reached because `protected={}` makes Gate 1 a no-op), so the #742 `store/`-symlink hazard stays caught; the residual is the narrow case of a different active task reading `data/issue_<self>/hf_dl/` directly while self self-reaps mid-run, with the cache re-downloadable.
